days_for_sue_type.description:
Type of days for protest:
                * `0` Calendar
                * `1` Business

days_for_revoke.description:
Calendar days for withdrawal
Supported banks: Itaú

sue_code.description: Protest code (CNAB 240 only). Check the possible values for each bank.

interest_type.description:
Interest/penalty type:
* `0` Non-existent (Default)
* `1` For daily percentage
* `2` For daily amount
* `7` For monthly percentage - Supported banks: Bradesco, BB, BTG, Caixa, Inter, Itaú, Safra, Santander, Sicoob and Sicredi

days_for_interest.description: Number of days after the due date when the penalty will start to accrue. The default value is 1 day (the day after the due date).

interest_percentage.description: Interest percentage. From 0.0 to 100.0 (Ex 1.5% = 1.5) Required if interest_type equals 1 or 7. Up to 2 decimal places.

interest_value.description: Daily interest amount (R$). Required if interest_type equals 2. Up to 2 decimal places.

discount_type.description:
Discount type:
                The discount type will be the same for all three discounts, if they exist. :
                * `0` Non-existent (Default)
                * `1` For fixed amount
                * `2` For percentage of boleto amount

days_for_discount.description: Days for discount. Required if discount_type is different from 0 (zero)

discount_percentage.description: Percentage of the boleto amount equivalent to the discount. Required if discount_type equals 2

discount_value.description: Discount amount (R$). Required if discount_type equals 1.

second_discount_percentage.description: Percentage of the boleto amount equivalent to the second discount.

third_discount_percentage.description: Percentage of the boleto amount equivalent to the third discount.

reduction_type.description:
Type of reduction:

`1`: Amount.
`2`: Percentage.
`3`: No reduction

reduction_amount.description: Reduction amount. Required if reduction_type equals 1.

reduction_percentage.description: Reduction percentage. Ex: 2% x R$ 250.00 = R$ 5.00. Required if reduction_type equals 2. Up to 2 decimal places.

divergent_payment_type.description:
Type of divergent payment:
* `1` Accepts any divergent amount
* `2` Accepts payments within a range of amounts or percentages
* `3` Does not accept divergent amount payments
* `4` Accepts payments above a minimum amount or percentage
Supported banks: Itaú

divergent_payment_value_type.description:
Type of value to consider for payment limits:
Valid only for Itaú and Caixa.
* `1` Reports divergent payments by amounts
* `2` Reports divergent payments by percentages
Supported banks: Itaú

divergent_payment_maximum_value.description:
Maximum value for divergent payment range.
Supported banks: Itaú

divergent_payment_minimum_value.description:
Minimum value for divergent payment range.
Supported banks: Itaú

divergent_payment_maximum_percentage.description:
Maximum percentage for divergent payment range.
Supported banks: Itaú

divergent_payment_minimum_percentage.description:
Minimum percentage for divergent payment range.
Supported banks: Itaú

fine_type.description:
Fine type:
* `0` Non-existent (Default)
* `1` For percentage of boleto amount
* `2` For fixed amount

days_for_fine.description: Number of days after the due date when the fine will start to accrue. The default value is 1 day (the day after the due date).

credit_bureau.description:
Credit Bureau/Negative Registry Agency.

`0`: Serasa.
`1`: Quod.
`2`: SPC

Options available for each supported bank:

* Banco do Brasil: Serasa and Quod.

days_for_negativation.description: Number of days after maturity to register negative on the title.

fine_percentage.description: Late fee percentage Ex: 2% x R$ 250.00 = R$ 5.00. Required if fine_type equals 1. Up to 2 decimal places.

fine_value.description: Fine amount (R$). Required if fine_type equals 2. Up to 2 decimal places.

document_number.description:
Document number, Size depends on the bank, format and sending method (API / EDI):
                                    * Itau |`Cnab240`|	10	|
                                    * Itau |`Cnab400`|	10	|

customer_city_name.description: City (Name must be correct and complete). Supported banks: Santander

guarantor_name.description: Final beneficiary name (Drawer/Guarantor). Supported banks: Santander

guarantor_cnpj_cpf.description: Final beneficiary CNPJ/CPF (Drawer/Guarantor). Supported banks: Santander

Control number:
                May contain any information of interest to the Company. The information contained in this field will always be returned with the respective title in the return file. Supported banks: Santander
